hk.review: Yes.onar questions onk easy hoy nd he is really understanding and easy going.tumi absent thakba agey inform korle,he'll consider it

Mgt489 jna although the grading can be unpredictable. jna sir takes only one mid btw. Soc103 is criminology n obviously HK sir- u'll have to read the book (like around 40/50pages but it's very interesting so u won't be bored) n mcqs r a bit conceptual but easy n the questions are direct. Sir counts the best quiz. Make sure ur topic is different - not the regular ones like robbery for the group project. Pad201 slk ma'm although the competition is huge. Or pol101edh-he gives sample questions b4 the exam- in case he doesn't then I could help you out. These r the courses that I did n under the above mentioned faculties n Alhamdulillah the grades were all good. All the best n make sure that you inform all ur respective faculties about ur absenteeism

I did pad201 with slk last year. I had full in the second mid n so did 6/7 other ppl so u can imagine the level of competition. But in mid1 there were 3 questions that u need to answer reasonably well- u won't find the examples to those 3 in her lectures but she'll mention it in the class but she won't repeat those examples in the review class n some ppl even requested her to check their answers b4 the exam but miss said that it wouldn't be fair. I think I have those 3 answers cuz I helped a friend but she said that she didn't repeat most of the questions that I had marked for her n to get full marks u need to memorize thoroughly to guarantee urself an A. For hk sir well I got full in both the mids n I didn't memorize n besides me only 1 person got full in mid 1 n 2ppl got full on mid 2- others got like 17/18/19/19.5 (this is to give u an idea so that u'll understand better). Secondly I believe that if u skip classes then u won't be able to do very well in pad cuz every class matters as she gives examples n explanations which she can't fully repeat in the review class. But for hk sir- reading the book thoroughly is enough but both the faculties leave 10% for attendance n both of them gives the chance to earn a bonus 1% on attendance (forgot slk mam's technique but hk sir holds seminars at times). Some1 mentioned asz -he's good but to get an A u need to record what he says. I had missed 5/6 classes in pol with edh sir but still ended up with an A- u just need to write a lot in the exams n questions can be managed but he takes unannounced quizzes n I was lucky not to remain absent on those days- he takes 5- 2 b4 mid 1, 1 b4 mid 2 n 2 b4 the final n counts best 4. Hope this suffices
